newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Portugal construction sector maintains growth.
newsitem.headline: Portugal construction sector maintains growth.

text.p: Construction activity in Portugal in the first quarter maintained the strong rate of growth seen in previous months and the outlook remains positive for 1997, the industry association ANEOP said.
"The sector is going though a good moment in its production cycle," it said in a report.
ANEOP bases its evaluations on sales of building materials, public investment, the value of public works in course and those awarded in the first quarter of 1997.
The indicator showing the value of work carried out rose 51 percent year-on-year in the period, it said. It forecast year-on-year growth of 48 percent for the second quarter.
February cement sales on the domestic market were up 26 percent year-on-year after a rise of 28.2 percent in January. It said that public investment was seen rising 7.5 percent this year.
